reviewedControls: Reconciliation SQL is BEGIN READ ONLY, owner SELECT only, no dispatch RPC or mutation.
Helper verifies accepted local source hashes, frozen manifest identity, and frozen plan before ledger or artifact processing.
Complete first-case accounting, full reservation, receipt digest, exact submissions and immutable pins required; uncertain or stopped execution is refused.
Official terminal run and exact job/attempt/wrapper metadata, complete expected artifact names, numeric IDs, repository identity, archive size and digest must match.
ZIP extraction accepts exactly one regular record.encrypted.json entry with bounded size; no archive path writes.
Accepted openEvaluationArtifact authenticates encrypted envelope and logical evaluation record before private output.
Raw bytes are written unchanged only into a newly created private directory, using exclusive mode0600 files; key bytes and plaintext buffers are cleared after use.
Printed result contains hashes, usage/status, IDs and control outcomes; raw bodies and private key are not printed.
Scanner accuracy, financial settlement and deployed HTTP latency are not inferred from successful retention.
limitations: Review is source inspection; reviewer did not invoke this root-only helper or read a private key.
Root must retain actual official terminal metadata, independent ledger reconciliation and post-run NOLOGIN/zero-session evidence.
An incomplete or stopped execution must be reported from actual evidence even if this complete-accounting helper refuses it.
